request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  400
error[ZC-E0121]: the lease settings cannot fence an agent in time
  cause  a lease ttl of 4000 ms leaves under 5000 ms past the 4000 ms fence
         margin for a renewal; the shortest ttl is 9000 ms
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    lengthen the lease ttl to at least the shortest, or use the default of 10000
  more   zcube explain E0121
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0121.html
